$description: GMT Gradient Explorer v2 — design tokens, snapshotted from the LIVE light-grey scheme on 2026-09-07. See hero-spec.md for the caveat about runtime generation.

viewport.$description: The ground. The wall sits on this.

dock.$description: Bands: top bar, hero, shelf. Never moves, no shadow.

section.$description: Floating things: trays, popovers, and the hero heading bar.

muted.$description: Captions, zone labels, inactive controls. The lowest level allowed to carry meaning.

dim.$description: Decorative only. NEVER put meaning here (V5).

base.$description: Hairlines. Always used at an alpha: /10 on bands, /20 on floating and bars, /40 on hover.

400.$description: Selected outline, slider fill. Means "this one" and nothing else (V3).

live.$description: Green. The pipeline is running off a live source.

edited.$description: Amber. Stops have been baked and edited.

armed.$description: Violet. This slot takes the next pick.

kept.$description: Gold-ish. The star. Shares the warn token for now - a real gold token is a Phase E question.

sample.$description: A sample you look at: swatch, wall tile, ramp, slider track.

press.$description: Something you press: button, input, image slot, heading bar.

float.$description: Something that floats: tray, popover, dialog.

segment.$description: Segmented controls and the stage tabs.

gutter.$description: THE left edge. Hero, search pill, tray, shelf all start here (V7).

stack.$description: Between stacked use buttons and palette swatches.

grid.$description: Everything else is a multiple of this.

zone.$description: SOURCE / USE / RECENT. Zone labels only.

control.$description: Every control and caption. The workhorse size.

tab.$description: Stage tabs and floating panel titles.

name.$description: The gradient's name. The ONLY large type on the screen.

hero-h.$description: Measured at 1280x800 with a picked gradient, no expander open.

hero-quiet-h.$description: Pointer has lived in the wall ~900ms.

slot.$description: The image slot, square. 56px tall when quiet.

hero-empty-h.$description: Source selected but empty; the last gradient stays on the ramp.
